scope.method: Read each current canonical narrative body in manifest order, and inspect current book narrative plan, part introductions, bridges, callouts, people guide, timeline and site sequence. Existing evidence is respected; this is composition review, not a fresh verification of every source or full film/book viewing.
scope.writes: This report only. No articles, metadata, images, books or Git altered.
scope.snapshot_note: Root began authorised revisions while this audit was being recorded. Per-article bindings therefore use the preserved before snapshot where available; these recommendations describe the baseline read, not a claim that an already-fixed passage remains current.

central_finding: The corpus already contains the humane material it needs. The main work is to let documented people and literary situations carry meaning, remove repeated explanations of that meaning, and give reference information a distinct home. Literature should be the narrative centre without making adaptation a test of a film’s worth.
first_three_priorities: Bring a literary encounter immediately after the personal invitation; the full overview is valuable reference but delays the stated purpose. The existing shortened book overture is already progress and should not be confused with the full web overview.

Build care from particular acts: publishing and translation, script development, shared performance, paid work, custody and access. Do not distribute the words care, invitation and shared work mechanically across every chapter.

Assign repeated material a main home: films hold story/ensemble/recognition, profiles hold working lives, economics explains settlement, futures holds general proposals. Keep a short independently intelligible mention and link where a standalone web article needs context.

reference_paths: Full web overview remains available as a companion, with dated counts/awards/announcements.
Bibliography remains an accessible reading companion rather than a compulsory inventory in the main narrative.
proposed_arc.ordering_caveat: This is a relationship-led reading order, not a chronology or an assertion of influence between adjacent works. Keep all 41 available; do not fabricate an adaptation origin for films without one.

book_plan_findings.finding: The book already uses a shortened opening and companion. Recomposition should move that brief orientation after the initial literary/voice encounter, not accidentally reinsert the full overview.

Introductions repeatedly announce names, connections, invitations and following. Use one concrete orientation per part and only meaningful boundary bridges; preserve the recorded distinction between rendered bridges and unused options.

The Rebati-to-radio, Bhagia/Saria-to-performers and restored-film callbacks can work because they identify actual earlier material. Avoid duplicating the same callback in the body, box and part introduction.
Retain the concise relationship map and exact roles, especially Chhotray screenplay rather than source novel; do not convert it into a ranking of important people.
This legacy field lists 27 slugs while the collection has 41. Do not use it as evidence of current full coverage; a new composition implementation should refresh review bookkeeping explicitly.

source_and_note_policy: Remove repeated derived facts before removing their evidence. Keep a useful citation for each connected factual claim group.
Preserve exact quotations, translators, creative credits and licence-required image attribution.
Move routine inspection/access-process language to evidence records; retain uncertainty that changes a claim: dates, language, role, proposed release, rights, financial basis and study limits.
Each article remains independently intelligible online; a short linked recap can remain even when the continuous book would omit it.
No fixed target note count: a short heavily factual profile may legitimately need several notes. Do not group unlike sources under an ambiguous marker.

line_art_proposal.principle: A small number of purposeful conceptual drawings can mark transitions or explain a relationship; they should not replace every actual portrait, document or evidence-bearing image.

failure_criteria: Any invented encounter, dialogue, sensory film observation, listening experience, private feeling or archival outcome.
Care becomes the author rescuing writers or communities rather than respecting their existing agency and choices.
Adaptation centrality becomes a hierarchy that dismisses original scripts, popular genres, documentaries or non-literary work.
Women, regional-language artists, workers or audiences appear only as tokens, unnamed support or beneficiaries.
Awards become proof of quality; reported receipts become profit; access listings become guaranteed playback; plans become completed outcomes.
Removing necessary disagreement or uncertainty solely to keep the story positive, especially DAMaN representation and healthcare evidence.
Repeating a question, invitation, credit-list justification or next-film programme at the end of most chapters.
Reducing note counts by obscuring sources or dropping required image/translation credits.
Changing the author’s approved memoir specifics or portrait preference without a new instruction.
Treating this planning audit as specialist human approval, full-film/full-book review, or permission to publish new drafts.

completion.implementation_status: Not implemented by reviewer; sequential quality review is separate.
